title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation: Bridging Exploitation and Imitation at the Token Level
abstract: arXiv:2605.06387v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with token-level teacher feedback and often outperforms off-policy distillation and standard reinforcement learning. However, we find that its standard advantage weighted policy gradient suffers from three structural weaknesses, including high variance updates, vanishing gradients in zero-advantage regions, and exploration bottlenecks when corrective signals are insufficient. We therefore propose Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation (AOPD), which replaces ineffective negative reinforcement with localized divergence minimization in non-positive advantage regions while preserving positive reinforcement learning. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that AOPD consistently outperforms standard OPD, with average gains of 4.09 / 8.34 under strong / weak initialization, respectively. translated_title: 非对称同策略蒸馏：在词元层面连接利用与模仿
translated_abstract: 同策略蒸馏（OPD）通过词元级别的教师反馈在学生模型自身的轨迹上进行训练，其表现通常优于离策略蒸馏和标准强化学习。然而，我们发现其标准的优势加权策略梯度存在三个结构性缺陷，包括更新方差过高、零优势区域的梯度消失，以及纠正信号不足时的探索瓶颈。因此，我们提出了非对称同策略蒸馏（AOPD），该方法在非正优势区域用局部散度最小化取代无效的负强化，同时保留正强化学习。在数学推理基准上的实验表明，AOPD 持续优于标准 OPD，在强/弱初始化条件下分别取得平均 4.09/8.34 的提升。此外，AOPD 在训练过程中还保持了更高的策略熵以及更好的（性能表现）。
tldr: 提出非对称同策略蒸馏（AOPD），通过在非正优势区域用局部散度最小化替代无效的负强化，解决了标准同策略蒸馏的高方差、梯度消失和探索瓶颈问题，在数学推理基准上分别于强弱初始化下取得 4.09 和 8.34 的平均性能提升。
en_tdlr: Proposes Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation (AOPD), which replaces ineffective negative reinforcement with localized divergence minimization in non-positive advantage regions to address high variance, vanishing gradients, and exploration bottlenecks, achieving average gains of 4.09/8.34 over standard OPD on mathematical reasoning benchmarks under strong/weak initialization.
